text: The week's behaviour changes centre on the Expense Agent and Payables Agent. #14492 registers the Expense Agent Copilot capability as Generally Available instead of Preview, #14491 moves E-Document LLM calls under the Payables Agent capability, and #14442 offers the Payables Agent again in a company recreated with the same name. Expense Agent work also includes configurable per diem rounding (#14136), approval setup fixes (#13910, backported in #13927), and API changes that expose the active approver and obsolete an unused FlowFilter (#13673). Partners get new extension events and a public Create Expense Report codeunit (#14346). Codeunits were renumbered in #14405 to avoid collisions with deprecated country apps. Posting and warehouse fixes cover item charges on purchase invoice cancellation (#13112), partial inventory picks with strict expiration (#14240), FEFO pick splitting (#13331), stale pick bins (#14013) and serial numbers when reversing capacity entries (#13206). Finance and localization fixes include #13676, #14184, #14139, #13613, #14297, #13854 and #14225. Other changes: Report Filename defaults (#13732), clearer Master Data Management errors (#14400, #14077), EAP cockpit details (#14480), demo data excluding the WorkIQ feature key (#13905), Navigate (#13904), and locked Transformation Rule codes (#9193). Type and buffer fixes are #14471 and #14423, and #14327 is test fixtures only.

issues: The opening sentence says the week's behaviour changes centre on the Expense Agent and Payables Agent. That framing is a little narrow: 26 of the 31 pull requests are flagged as behaviour changes, and most of them are posting, warehouse, finance and localization fixes, not agent work.

The finance and localization sentence lists seven pull request numbers (#13676, #14184, #14139, #13613, #14297, #13854, #14225) without saying what any of them do. That makes the sentence less useful. Short labels would help, for example dispute status on ledger entries, the electronic payment Document No. fix, Czech compensation lookup events, Australian VAT/GST additional currency, German ELMA export status, VAT Entries filters, and the purchase credit memo return shipment regression.
